note: Every control has real logic. evaluator = function in scripts/diagnose/controls.py, or null when planned (implemented_in later).

controls.title: Conversion signal present
inputs: account export CSV with clicks and conversions
controls.rule: Over the analysis window, clicks > 0 and conversions == 0 means tracking is likely broken.
controls.evidence_required: S15 check conversion_signal_present on the export
controls.unknown: no export supplied or no clicks/conversions columns

controls.title: Export data quality has no blockers
controls.rule: Any S15 check with severity blocker that fails (negative metrics, clicks > impressions, duplicate keys, unparseable or future dates, missing required columns).
controls.evidence_required: S15 result id and the failed check names
controls.fail: one or more failed blocker checks

controls.title: Funnel counts are plausible
controls.rule: Summed over mature periods, each stage count must not exceed the previous stage count (cohort-consistent funnel).
controls.evidence_required: stage totals from the S16 input window
controls.pass: every stage total <= previous stage total
controls.fail: any stage total > previous stage total (double counting or mixed definitions)

controls.title: Enough mature periods for a verdict
controls.rule: Mature periods (age >= this account's lag) must be >= min_periods for a valid S16 verdict. Low data never blocks: it caps confidence.

controls.title: Constraint identified with corroboration
controls.rule: Statistical starvation at the first starving stage plus an operational signal on the same link gives high confidence; one of the two gives medium; boundary-inconclusive gives low and a disambiguating test.
controls.evidence_required: S16 id, stage CI vs required volume, operational signal source
controls.pass: constraint found with confidence medium or high
controls.fail: constraint found only at low confidence with no disambiguating test proposed
controls.unknown: no T* or no stage targets

controls.title: Owner hypothesis tested, not used as evidence
controls.rule: Compare the owner's stated bottleneck with the S16 constraint link. Report match or mismatch; never add it to evidence.
controls.evidence_required: context field provenance and S16 id
controls.fail: hypothesis contradicts the S16 constraint (report both)

controls.title: No flip-flops in the last 30 days
controls.rule: Same entity changed in opposite directions within 30 days (ledger flipflops).

controls.title: No new change on a link inside an open measurement window
controls.rule: If a decision on the constraint link is applied or measuring and its window has not ended, exploit actions are frozen until the window closes.
controls.evidence_required: open decision id and window end date
controls.pass: no open window on the constraint link

controls.title: Quality Score components vs own distribution
inputs: keyword export with QS components, impressions, cost
controls.rule: Impression-weighted share of below-average components per ad group compared with the account's own distribution; low-volume keywords are unknown; CPC impact is estimated via S13.
controls.evidence_required: export path, S13 id for any CPC figure
controls.fail: component share worse than account P75 on top-spend ad groups

controls.title: Negative keyword candidates are evidence-based
controls.rule: A term is a negative candidate only if S09 verdict is likely_below (P(CVR >= break-even) <= profile.risk.negative_p_max) or it fails intent review with CRM evidence. Generic lists are refused.
controls.pass: every proposed negative has S09 likely_below or CRM evidence

controls.title: Profitable terms are not budget-limited
inputs: campaign export with search lost IS (budget), CPA or ROAS
controls.rule: Campaigns with lost IS (budget) above their own baseline while CPA CI upper bound < target CPA (or ROAS CI lower bound > break-even ROAS).
controls.evidence_required: S01 id for CPA/ROAS CI, export path
controls.pass: no profitable campaign limited by budget

controls.title: Platform conversions reconcile with CRM
controls.rule: Ratio platform/CRM with CI; tolerance scales with volume. Outside tolerance = measurement integrity blocker.
